## Vireo v0.14.3

Same changes as v0.14.2, now built for both platforms. The v0.14.2 Windows build was stopped by a test that failed only when it ran in parallel on Windows, so v0.14.2 shipped for macOS only. Use this release on Windows.

### Included from v0.14.2

- **Editor and diff text sized for the Mac.** On macOS the code editor is now 12.5px and the diff view 12px, in line with the rest of the UI and VS Code's Mac defaults. Windows is unchanged (`41c483c`).
- **Safer git commands.** Vireo now also refuses `--output` and `--open-files-in-pager` (including `git grep -O`), which could overwrite an arbitrary file or start a program if a request value ever reached git as an option. Harmless options with similar names still work (`6774f1e`).

### Fixes

- **tests:** the `vx` cross-run anchor test no longer depends on which other tests run at the same time (`cc162c5`).

### Installing on macOS

The macOS build is not notarized, so the first launch of a downloaded copy needs one extra step: open Vireo once, then go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**. You can also run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Vireo.app` in Terminal.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Cosmos-0118/vireo/compare/v0.14.1...v0.14.3
